metadataRaw.title: How to INSTANTLY Relieve Groin Pain
metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe shows how to instantly relieve groin pain.

A major cause of groin (and inner leg) pain is a build-up of weakness and tightness in the main muscles that support this area. These muscles include the adductors and psoas.

To fix this, we’ll go over easy exercises that help release (stretch) tightness and strengthen these muscles for both quick and long-lasting relief.

Each exercise works differently, targeting different muscles and being performed in different positions. To get the best results, go through them all and use the ones that provide you with the most groin pain relief.

Watch now to quickly relieve groin pain!

0:45 Bed/Floor Exercise
2:30 Seated Exercise
